children: Valeura Energy approved FID for Phase 1 of the Bussabong gas field (40% WI) in Thailand, targeting first gas around end-2028 with capex of ~$35M for facilities plus $20–25M for drilling, net to Valeura. Planned output is ~30 mmcf/d in 2029 and ~40 mmcf/d in 2030 (gross).

De-risks first organic gas project in Thailand and starts capex cycle.

Defines spend profile (2027–2028) and capital needs; no 2026 spend.
Drilling capex $20–25M (net)
Sets expected well investment for initial 25 wells.
First gas ~end-2028
Establishes timeline to cash flow and production ramp.
Gross 30 mmcf/d in 2029
Implies 12 mmcf/d net to Valeura; revenue visibility pending GSA.
